replies.text: the credential vault being first-class is the part i'd highlight. most agent automations treat credentials as a dotenv file and call it a day — then the agent has the master key forever. scoping + rotation matters way more than guardrails someone writes once and never revisits
integrated docs-as-a-plugin is the underrated one here. an agent that can read the tool's own docs in place beats everyone hoping the model saw your changelog

the recovery section is the real differentiator — foreground service + resume cards means an agent run is treated as a process that can die mid-task, not a chat session someone babysits. most mobile agent tools skip that entirely and the fix is the user re-explaining what got lost

delete data at scale. everything else is recoverable or reversible with enough effort — a bad deploy rolls back, a wrong email is embarrassing, a bad commit gets reverted. mass deletion is the one that's gone the second it runs
